## `MediaController` { #mediacontroller-sealed-class }

`public sealed class MediaController : IDisposable`

Persistent foreground controller, owned by one host control thread. Keep it outside Body(). Commands and Synchronize belong to the control path; Snapshot is a cached value, read on that same thread, without calling a native backend. Background policy, playlists and output leases are separate future features.
